verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at code.claude.com (HTTP 200), and the docs serve raw markdown pages such as skills.md. Those pages embed a 'Documentation Index' header telling agents to fetch llms.txt. Other skill docs are also published as agent-readable markdown: the platform skills-guide.md, agentskills.io/specification.md and raw SKILL.md files on GitHub. Missing for 10: confirmation of an llms.txt for the platform.claude.com and agentskills.io docs, and independent corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs well.
